caption: The drawing contains three rectangular swatches of patterned fabric, arranged vertically in the center of a beige-colored background. The top swatch is light pink with a delicate pattern of small red flowers and thin, wavy lines connecting them. The middle swatch has a red background filled with a dense floral pattern in shades of white, pink, and green, with flowers and leaves distributed across the surface. The bottom swatch has a tan background with bold, irregular red shapes and a single white shape resembling a leaf superimposed on one of the red areas. In the bottom right corner, the name "Edmond R. Leats" is written in red text.
